name: me-network
title: ME Network
author: rykon_
description: An ME storage network inspired by Applied Energistics 2: cables, a controller, drives with storage cells that keep their contents, a terminal, interfaces, import, export and storage buses, autocrafting with encoded patterns and crafting CPUs, level maintainers, and fluids. Works on its own with vanilla recipes; Gregtorio Continued puts it on its GregTech tiers. Source and issues: https://github.com/Rykon00/me-network
